ABOUT OTRA

TIRES, SERVICE & SUPPORT.
RIGHT HERE IN WESTMINSTER.

From new and used tires to mobile tire assistance and roadside help, OTRA is here to help Westminster-area drivers get moving. Stop by the shop on W 72nd Avenue or reach out to ask about service availability.

Need tires for your daily driver, work truck, or commercial vehicle? Talk with the team about tire options, wheel service, and the best next step for your situation.
